field.name: Identity
field.summary: The cached Orleans serialization identity used to build the envelope header.

field.name: Header
field.summary: The cached pre-built envelope header bytes for the Orleans serializer identity.

field.name: ManifestProviderBaseTypeName
field.summary: The full type name of the Orleans TypeManifestProviderBase class used to identify generated manifest provider service registrations.

field.name: Provider
field.summary: The lazily created service provider used to initialize Orleans serialization services once per process.

field.name: Serializer
field.summary: The lazily resolved Orleans serializer instance obtained from the cached service provider.

method.name: Deserialize
method.summary: Deserialize an instance from a byte array using the Orleans serializer.
method.param: Byte array containing the serialized data.
method.returns: Deserialized instance of the requested type.

method.name: DeserializeMemory
method.summary: Deserialize an instance from a memory block using the Orleans serializer.
method.returns: Deserialized instance of the requested type.

method.name: FromFile
method.summary: Read and deserialize an instance from a file using the Orleans serializer.
method.returns: Deserialized instance if the file exists and was read successfully; otherwise null.

method.name: Serialize
method.summary: Serialize an instance to a byte array using the Orleans serializer.
method.typeparam: The type of the instance to serialize.
method.returns: Byte array containing the serialized instance.

method.name: ToBase64String
method.summary: Serialize an instance to a Base64-encoded string using the Orleans serializer.
method.typeparam: The type of the instance to serialize.
method.returns: Base64-encoded representation of the serialized instance.

method.name: ToFile
method.summary: Serialize and write an instance to a file using the Orleans serializer.
method.typeparam: The type of the instance to serialize.
method.returns: True if the file was created and written successfully; false if the file already exists or an error occurred.

method.name: ParseBase64
method.summary: Deserialize an instance from a Base64-encoded string using the Orleans serializer.
method.param: Base64-encoded string containing the serialized data.
method.returns: Deserialized instance if parsing succeeds; otherwise null.

method.name: TryParseBase64
method.summary: Attempt to deserialize an instance from a Base64-encoded string using the Orleans serializer.
method.param: Base64-encoded string containing the serialized data.
Deserialized instance if the operation succeeds; otherwise default.
method.returns: True if parsing succeeded; otherwise false.

method.name: CreateProvider
method.summary: Create the singleton service provider used to resolve the Orleans serializer runtime.
method.returns: Configured service provider containing Orleans serialization services.

method.name: PruneManifests
method.summary: Remove duplicate Orleans TypeManifestProvider service registrations that originate from assemblies loaded in a different AssemblyLoadContext than the calling assembly. This prevents duplicate type alias collisions when the same assembly is loaded in both an isolated context and the host's default context.
method.param: The service collection populated by AddSerializer to prune.
